svg.title: Akasha Azhar. Assalam-o-Alaikum.
svg.desc: AiSecOps engineer, offensive security, autonomous AI agents, founder of NextaSol. I break software to learn how to build it safer, then build AI agents that do the work with me. Based in Rawalpindi / Islamabad.
